LIKELY_CAUSE: Data inconsistency in target application (e.g. missing customer/material master record)
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Check IDoc segment data in WE02/WE05; verify referenced master data exists; reprocess via BD87

LIKELY_CAUSE: Syntax or structural error while adding the IDoc to the database
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Review IDoc control record and segment structure against the message type definition; check partner profile (WE20)

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: IDoc ready to be transferred to application
LIKELY_CAUSE: Not an error state, but IDocs stuck here indicate the inbound processing job did not run
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Check background job scheduling for RBDAPP01 / workflow; verify inbound processing is not deactivated in WE20

LIKELY_CAUSE: A custom exit or user-status routine explicitly stopped processing
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Debug the associated function module / process code in WE42; check custom Z-exits

LIKELY_CAUSE: Distribution model (BD64) misconfigured or filter object excluding the record
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Review distribution model and filter/segment filters; regenerate partner profiles

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Error during syntax check of IDoc (outbound)
LIKELY_CAUSE: IDoc structure does not match the basic type definition (missing mandatory segment)
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Compare IDoc type (WE30) against generated data; check segment release/version

LIKELY_CAUSE: Communication channel (RFC destination / file port) unreachable or misconfigured
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Test RFC destination in SM59; verify port definition in WE21; check target system availability

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Error passing data to port (outbound, dispatch)
LIKELY_CAUSE: tRFC queue stuck or destination system down at dispatch time
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Check tRFC monitor (SM58); reprocess stuck LUWs; confirm target availability

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Duplicate IDoc detected for same business document
LIKELY_CAUSE: Sender retried after a timeout without receiving acknowledgment, or interface lacks idempotency key
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Implement duplicate-check logic on the natural key (PO/order number) before posting; enable IDoc duplicate check in partner profile

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: BAPI_RETURN type E - mandatory field missing
LIKELY_CAUSE: Calling program did not populate a required structure field
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Inspect BAPI_RETURN table for field name; validate mapping populates all mandatory fields before BAPI call

LIKELY_CAUSE: Communication user lacks authorization object for the target transaction
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Add missing authorization object/values to the communication user's role via SU53 trace

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: BAPI commit not executed / changes rolled back
LIKELY_CAUSE: Caller invoked the BAPI but never called BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Ensure orchestration layer explicitly commits after a successful BAPI call sequence

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Duplicate document number in BAPI create
LIKELY_CAUSE: Number range buffer exhausted or external number assignment reused
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Check number range object (SNRO); switch to internal assignment or extend buffer

LIKELY_CAUSE: SAP Gateway/application server down, or network path blocked
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Check ST22/SM21 on target; validate network route and firewall rules; verify RFC destination load balancing

LIKELY_CAUSE: TCP session dropped mid-call, often due to timeout or gateway restart
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Increase RFC timeout parameter; check SAP Gateway logs (dev_rfc.trc); enable retry with backoff

LIKELY_CAUSE: Expired password, locked user, or incorrect client/system number in RFC destination
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Reset service user credentials; verify RFC destination (SM59) client/system parameters

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Short dump in remote-enabled function module
LIKELY_CAUSE: Unhandled exception in custom RFC-enabled FM logic
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Analyze ST22 short dump; add explicit exception handling in the function module

LIKELY_CAUSE: Client sent a payload that does not match the OData service's EDM metadata
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Validate payload against $metadata; check for missing navigation properties or type mismatches

LIKELY_CAUSE: Missing or expired OAuth token / basic-auth credentials
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Refresh OAuth token; verify communication arrangement and communication system credentials

LIKELY_CAUSE: Write operation (POST/PUT) sent without a valid X-CSRF-Token header
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Fetch CSRF token via GET with X-CSRF-Token: Fetch header before the write call

LIKELY_CAUSE: Incorrect entity set name or key value in the request URL
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Confirm entity set name against service metadata; validate key encoding (special characters)

LIKELY_CAUSE: ETag mismatch; the entity was updated by another process since it was last read
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Re-fetch the entity to get the current ETag before retrying the update (optimistic concurrency)

LIKELY_CAUSE: Client exceeded the tenant's configured rate limit
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Implement exponential backoff and request batching; review BTP service plan rate limits

LIKELY_CAUSE: Segment/element failed EDI standard or trading-partner-specific validation
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Review 997 AK3/AK4 loop for the failing segment/element; correct mapping and resend

LIKELY_CAUSE: Source field value outside the expected code list for the target mapping (e.g. unknown UOM code)
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Extend the mapping's code-list lookup table; add default/error-queue handling for unmapped codes

LIKELY_CAUSE: Downstream HTTP receiver adapter exceeded configured timeout under load
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Increase receiver adapter timeout; check downstream system performance; consider async/queued pattern

LIKELY_CAUSE: Persistent downstream failure exceeded the configured number of automatic retries
RESOLUTION_STEPS: Investigate root cause in downstream system; use Message Processing Log manual resend after fix
